optimizedContext.value:
# skills:skill-templates-source

## Rules

### Template source location
- Source templates live in `packages/skills/templates/`:
  - `packages/skills/templates/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md.tpl` (standard skills)
  - `packages/skills/templates/agents/<agent-name>/SPECD-AGENT.md.tpl` (specialized agents)
- All template sources MUST use `.md.tpl` extension; installed outputs emit as `.md`.
- Directories MUST include metadata contract file (`skill.meta.json` or `specd-agent.meta.json`).

### Template migration
- Directory layout: `templates/skills/`, `templates/agents/`, `templates/shared/`.
- `templates/skills/` MUST NOT contain `specd-metadata/` template; metadata optimization handled via agent templates.
- `shared.meta.json` MUST NOT be canonical source of truth for shared template consumers.

### Template metadata contract
- Metadata files (`skill.meta.json` / `specd-agent.meta.json`) schema:
```json
{
  "kind": "skill" | "agent",
  "supportedCapabilities": ["mcp", "agents", "frontmatter"],
  "requiredCapabilities": [],
  "requiredSharedTemplates": ["shared.md"]
}
```
- `kind` MUST match parent directory (`skills/` or `agents/`).

### Capability-aware install-time rendering
- Render model MUST be deterministic, single-pass Handlebars without arbitrary code execution.
- Capabilities:
  - `mcp`: enables MCP tool/workflow branches.
  - `agents`: enables delegated agent/subagent branches.
  - `frontmatter`: enables frontmatter insertion from `variables.frontmatter`.
- Shared references MUST use `@{{sharedFolder}}/shared.md`; `sharedFolder` remains relative to project root.

### Graph impact terminology in workflow templates
- Impact terminology and flags:
  - `dependents`: symbols/files depending on target (`--direction dependents`, `--direction upstream` compatibility).
  - `dependencies`: symbols/files target depends on (`--direction dependencies`, `--direction downstream` compatibility).
  - `both`: combined (`--direction both`).
  - File selectors MUST use `--file <path1> <path2> ...`, NOT `--changes`.
- Templates MUST NOT refer to `downstream` as dependents.

### Graph search snippet guidance in workflow templates
- `specd graph search` preview content MUST be opt-in via `--snippet`.
- Omit `--snippet` when requesting identifiers/locations; `snippet` field omitted in `json`/`toon` without `--snippet`.

### Frontmatter source & injection
- Frontmatter derived from canonical skill metadata & vendor runtime contracts.
- Plugins MUST pass structured data via `variables.frontmatter`, NEVER prebuilt YAML documents.
- `@specd/skills` injects frontmatter ONLY if `frontmatter` capability present. Shared files NEVER receive runtime frontmatter.
- Runtime model coverage:
  - Codex: `name`, `description`
  - Copilot: `name`, `description`, `license`, `allowed-tools`, `user-invocable`, `disable-model-invocation`
  - Open Code: `name`, `description`, `license`, `compatibility`, `metadata`

### Implementation tracking instructions in templates
- Workflows linking code to specs MUST mention `specd changes implementation add`.
- Archive workflows MUST resolve/review tracked implementation files before archive.

### Metadata self-healing guidance in workflow templates
- Workflow templates MUST NOT scan for status values (`stale`, `missing`, `invalid`).
- `specd spec generate-metadata` MUST be presented strictly as explicit forced-rebuild/repair tool, never routine step.

### Optimizer agent gating declared in templates
- Agent templates (`specd-project-context-optimizer`, `specd-spec-context-optimizer`) MUST gate work on `llmOptimizedContext` == true.
- Direct persistence strictly through `cli:spec-optimizations` commands; do NOT invoke metadata generation after persistence.

## Constraints

- Templates MUST NOT contain static frontmatter YAML blocks.
- Source files MUST use `.md.tpl` extension.
- Each skill dir MUST contain `skill.meta.json`.
- `shared.meta.json` MUST NOT be canonical source for shared template requirements.
- Installed markdown MUST NOT contain absolute filesystem paths.
- Workflow templates MUST prefer `--direction dependents` / `--direction dependencies` and `--file`, NEVER `--changes`.
